description: This file contains the implementation of a LocationHandler class responsible for managing location permissions and fetching device location data in an Android app. It includes interfaces for data sources, a default data source implementation, and methods for handling location requests with various parameters, along with permission checks and error handling.

classes.name: LocationDataSource
classes.description: An interface defining methods for checking location permissions and fetching location data.

classes.name: DefaultLocationDataSource
classes.description: A default implementation of LocationDataSource that interacts with LocationCaptureManager to retrieve location data.

classes.name: LocationHandler
classes.description: Main class for handling location permissions, fetching location data, and processing parameters related to location requests.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has fine location permission.

methods.name: hasCoarseLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has coarse location permission.

methods.name: handleLocationGet
methods.description: Handles a location request, including permission validation, parameter parsing, and error handling.

methods.name: parseLocationParams
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters for location request configuration such as maxAgeMs, timeoutMs, and desiredAccuracy.
